test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of this sentence:

(A) rising inflation

(B) causes difficulties

(C) for middle-class families

(D) everywhere
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **ABCD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The sentence begins with **part (A)**, "rising inflation," which is the subject of the sentence.
 
• Following the subject, **part (B)**, "causes difficulties," logically explains what rising inflation leads to.
 
• Next, **part (C)**, "for middle-class families," specifies who faces these difficulties.
 
• Finally, **part (D)**, "everywhere," concludes the sentence by indicating the universality of the problem.

Therefore, the correct answer is **ABCD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Option 1 (BCAD):** This sequence starts with "causes difficulties rising inflation for middle-class families everywhere," which disrupts the subject-verb agreement and logical flow.
 
• **Option 2 (BACD):** This sequence begins with "rising inflation difficulties causes for middle-class families everywhere," which is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4 (BACD):** This is identical to Option 2 and therefore incorrect for the same reason.
